items.title: Debit Card Purchases Grew at Double the Rate of Credit in October, New Velera Data Reveal
items.why: Debit outpacing credit hints at softer revolving spend, so track premium card spend mix closely.
items.summary_ai: Velera data shows debit card purchases grew at twice the pace of credit card purchases in October.
items.take: Debit outpacing credit hints at softer revolving spend, so track premium card spend mix closely.
data_points: Debit growth about 2x credit growth, October
